name: com.caelaralabs/geo
title: Caelara Labs Global Locale
description: Caelara Labs Global Locale tools over remote MCP. Calls need an X-Caelara-Key API key.

tools.name: global_scheduling_composite
tools.description: Find meeting slots that fall inside working hours for every participant timezone, skipping weekends and public holidays, with per-participant local times. Use when you need to find meeting times inside everyone's working hours across time zones, skipping weekends and public holidays. Example input: ?timezones=America/New_York,Europe/London&date=2026-11-24.

timezones.description: Comma list of IANA timezones; the first is the organizer whose local day anchors the search

countries.description: Comma list of ISO alpha-2 codes aligned with timezones, used to skip public holidays

tools.name: cross_border_checkout_composite
tools.description: Cross-border checkout quote: FX conversion into the destination currency, VAT/GST, postal-code validation and EU reverse-charge eligibility. Use when you need to quote a cross-border checkout: currency conversion, VAT or GST, postal-code validation and EU reverse-charge eligibility. Example input: ?amount=120&currency=USD&country=DE.

amount.description: Order subtotal in the source currency

currency.description: Source currency ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD

prices_include_tax.description: true when the amount already includes tax

vat_id.description: Buyer VAT ID for B2B reverse-charge screening (format only, not VIES-verified)

origin_country.description: Seller country (ISO alpha-2) for reverse-charge screening

tools.name: timezone_converter
tools.description: Convert a date-time between IANA timezones with offsets, abbreviations and DST flags

to.description: Comma list of target IANA timezones

time.description: ISO 8601 time; wall time is read in the source timezone (default now)

tools.name: business_hours_calc
tools.description: Is a location open right now (or at a given instant) and when does it next open or close

tools.name: public_holiday_lookup
tools.description: Public holidays for a country and year, with an optional is-holiday check for one date

tools.name: live_fx_rates
tools.description: Live currency (FX) rates for a base currency with optional amount conversion

symbols.description: Comma list of target currencies (default major set)

amount.description: Amount of the base currency to convert

tools.name: vat_gst_rate_lookup
tools.description: Standard and reduced VAT/GST rates for a country with optional tax amount calculation

amount.description: Net amount to compute tax on

tools.name: postal_code_validator
tools.description: Validate and normalize a postal code for a country

tools.name: country_iso_enricher
tools.description: Resolve a country name or ISO code to alpha-2/alpha-3/numeric codes, currency, calling code, region, capital and primary timezone

q.description: Country name, alpha-2, alpha-3 or numeric code

tools.name: distance_haversine_calc
tools.description: Great-circle distance, initial bearing and midpoint between two coordinates

tools.name: guard__eval
tools.description: Pre-execution policy check over an action digest; returns an Ed25519-signed pass (allow, review or block)

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the action payload (the payload itself is never sent)

context_meta.description: Small object the rules can read (amounts, labels)

prev_receipt_hash.description: Receipt hash of the previous step, chained into the pass

spend_cap_egu.description: Spend cap to bind into the pass

target_recipient.description: Recipient to bind into the pass (only its SHA-256 is signed)

policy.description: Rules: { rules: [{ id, path, op, value }], schema?, on_fail?: review|block, review_rules?: [ids] }

tools.name: guard__spend_check
tools.description: Pre-spend check before a payment service is called: per-payment and daily limits, blocked categories, a merchant allow-list and an approval threshold, plus a Caelara Shield screen of the merchant domain; answers allow, escalate or block with plain-English reasons and a hash-only signed clearance receipt, and opens a single-use one-tap approval on escalate. Never pays and never moves money. Heuristic screening — will miss attacks

amount.description: Amount about to be spent, greater than 0

currency.description: ISO 4217 code (USD) or a short asset symbol

merchant_domain.description: Merchant domain, screened by Caelara Shield (send this or destination_hash)

destination_hash.description: Or the SHA-256 of the destination, computed by the caller (64 hex)

category.description: Spend category, e.g. travel or gambling

rules.description: Spend rules: { max_per_tx?, daily_cap?, spent_today?, allow_domains?: [domains or destination hashes], block_categories?: [], require_hitl_above? } (may be empty)

tools.name: keys__delegate
tools.description: Mint a scoped, expiring sub-key with a hard EGU spend cap reserved from this key

max_egu.description: Spend cap reserved from this key

allowed_suites.description: Route families or hosts the sub-key may call, e.g. ["guard","sandbox","scratchpad","hitl"]

require_prev_receipt_hash.description: Require X-Prev-Receipt-Hash continuity on every call

tools.name: kya__attest
tools.description: Know-your-agent pass: proves operator control of a domain (agent card or DNS TXT) and reports settlement-address posture

settlement_address.description: Settlement address declared by the operator, checked against the agent card

tools.name: provenance__commit
tools.description: Commit a payload digest to a hash-only audit chain; returns a signed receipt

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of what you are recording

prev_receipt_hash.description: Receipt hash this commit follows (or send X-Prev-Receipt-Hash)

tools.name: provenance__verify
tools.description: Verify a provenance receipt and walk its chain

tools.name: reputation__score
tools.description: Privacy-preserving 7-day risk score (0 low to 100 high) for a key fingerprint or domain

subject.description: SHA-256 key fingerprint, or "self" with a key

domain.description: Operator domain instead of a fingerprint

tools.name: route__negotiate
tools.description: Declarative routing: an intent and a max_egu ceiling return native routes ranked by their 7-day success record, then caller-supplied connectors; with execute, verified failover across the connectors you hold keys for

intent.description: What the call should do, for example "scrape a page to markdown"

execute.description: Optional { connector, path, method, body, expect }: run through your own provider key (X-Byok-<Provider>), with an expect JSON schema checked before settlement

tools.name: events__relay
tools.description: Signed Edge Webhook Relay: an ingest URL for a provider webhook; every event is signed with Ed25519 and delivered to your https destination at once, with nothing stored

deliver_to.description: Your https destination on a named public host

ttl_seconds.description: How long the ingest URL works, 60 to 86400 (default 3600)

tools.name: ultra__run
tools.description: Caelara Ultra: chained deterministic verification, up to 10 policy steps in one call, each step digest linked into the next; one Ed25519-signed chain receipt

policy.description: Policy applied to every step: rules and/or a JSON schema, as in /v1/guard/eval

steps.description: Ordered inputs (1 to 10 objects) evaluated in sequence; a failing step stops the chain

prev_receipt_hash.description: Receipt hash of a previous call, linked into the first step

tools.name: sandbox__eval
tools.description: Deterministic JavaScript (QuickJS): no network, filesystem or environment, 32 MB, 50 ms; Ed25519-signed execution receipt

code.description: Source, up to 64 KB; the completion value is the result

input_json.description: JSON input, available as the global input

tools.name: shield__inspect
tools.description: One verdict (allow, warn or block) with reason codes over a URL, text and/or file fingerprint: lookalike and deceptive addresses, injection and secret patterns; nothing stored; signed receipt

url.description: An address about to be opened, up to 4096 characters

text.description: Text about to be sent or pasted, up to 50,000 characters

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of a file about to be opened (64 hex)

tools.name: media__stamp
tools.description: Originality stamp: a signed, timestamped receipt over the SHA-256 of a file computed on your device; the file is never sent

screen_text.description: Optional words the file was made from (up to 5,000 characters): screened by Caelara Shield in the same call; only their SHA-256 is signed

tools.name: media__create
tools.description: Creator tools: a visual card from your text or a page, an extractive brief of a page or text, or an originality stamp; screened by Caelara Shield first, signed receipt, returned inline, nothing stored

prompt.description: visual_card: the card text, 1 to 280 characters

source_url.description: visual_card or link_pack: a public web page to read

text.description: link_pack: pasted text, up to 100,000 characters

media_type.description: stamp: video, audio, image or document

tools.name: builders__id
tools.description: A public, non-spendable builder ID for this key's account, for share links: send it as X-Builder-Id to credit the 10% EGU compute rebate without sharing a key

tools.name: execution__verify
tools.description: Caelara Proof: check an Execution Passport (signature, digest and every chain link) or turn any network receipt into passport form; nothing sent is stored

tools.name: negotiate__compare
tools.description: Negotiation Engine: a dry run that scores candidate plans on measured latency, the live 7-day record of every step and EGU cost, and recommends one; nothing is executed

objective.description: What to get done (compiles the default and the network-only plan)

plans.description: Or 1 to 5 plans from /v1/intent/plan to compare

tools.name: negotiate__commit
tools.description: Negotiation Engine: run a compiled plan step by step for its validated total EGU, inside your key's scopes, with Caelara Shield screens, failover for services run with your own key, and expect schemas checked before settlement; a stopped run is not charged. Returns an Execution Passport

inputs.description: Per step id: the body (or query) for that step

expect.description: Per step id: a JSON schema the step output must satisfy

tools.name: intent__plan
tools.description: Intent Compiler: an objective, constraints and a max_egu budget compile into an ordered, schema-checked plan of Caelara Genome capabilities, with a Caelara Shield screen before every external action; the plan carries its own SHA-256

objective.description: What to get done, in steps if you like: "check this link, then post the summary"

max_egu.description: Budget for the whole plan, 1 to 1000 (default 20)

tools.name: intent__validate
tools.description: Intent Compiler: re-check a plan (hash, known capabilities, Shield screens, order, schemas, budget) before you run it

tools.name: genome__query
tools.description: Caelara Genome: capability records matching a need (native routes, then services you run with your own key), each with input and output schemas, security requirements, dependencies, expected EGU, failure modes, provenance and its live 7-day record

q.description: The need, for example "screen a link before posting"

max_egu.description: Only records expected to cost at most this much

tools.name: genome__compose
tools.description: Caelara Genome: check an ordered chain of capability records as one pipeline, with total expected EGU, combined security requirements and the Caelara Shield screens it needs

ids.description: 1 to 10 record ids from /.well-known/genome.json, in order

tools.name: find_stack
tools.description: Find a stack for what you want to build, free first: open-source projects, browser and WebAssembly libraries and free MCP servers (permissive licences, screened by Caelara Shield), then metered network routes with exact prices, then commercial providers when the work needs them

query.description: What you want to build, e.g. "pdf parser", "voiceover", "link scanner"

runtime.description: browser, node, python or mcp (default browser)

tools.name: bounties__post
tools.description: Post a machine-verifiable task with a proof-gated EGU reward (released only on a passing output; never custodial escrow)

reward_units.description: Reward in EGU, locked until claimed or expired

acceptance.description: Acceptance: { schema?, rules?, proof?: { execution_receipt?: { code_sha256?, exit_code? }, signed_pass?: { verdict?, action_type?, sub? } } }

tools.name: bounties__open
tools.description: Open bounties, filterable by tag, minimum reward and expiry

tools.name: bounties__claim
tools.description: Submit an output (with an execution receipt or signed pass when required); a pass releases the reward with a signed receipt

execution_receipt.description: Execution receipt from /v1/sandbox/eval, when the bounty requires one

signed_pass.description: Signed pass from /v1/guard/eval, when the bounty requires one

tools.name: hitl__escalate
tools.description: Ask a human to approve an action; an approval returns a single-use Ed25519 approval pass

summary.description: Up to 280 characters; redacted before storage

target.description: HTTPS webhook URL, or the reviewer key fingerprint (or "parent" for a sub-key)

tools.name: hitl__status
tools.description: Escalation status, with the approval pass once approved

tools.name: hitl__verify
tools.description: Verify a single-use approval pass online and mark it used (a second check reports already_used)

tools.name: scratchpad__put
tools.description: Store a client-encrypted blob (and optional vector) with a hard TTL

key.description: Item key (only its SHA-256 is stored)

ciphertext_b64.description: Client-encrypted bytes, base64, up to 64 KB

tools.name: scratchpad__query
tools.description: Exact key lookup, or cosine search over live items

tools.name: rpc__screen
tools.description: Protected RPC pre-execution screen: decodes a Solana sendTransaction or EVM eth_sendRawTransaction call and returns allow, warn or block with reason codes. Heuristic screening — will miss attacks. Never forwards, broadcasts, signs or submits the transaction.

method.description: sendTransaction (Solana) or eth_sendRawTransaction (EVM); or send the call as request

params.description: The JSON-RPC params: the signed transaction first (Solana: base58 or base64 with { encoding })

request.description: The whole JSON-RPC call { jsonrpc, id, method, params }

tools.name: keys__trial_key
tools.description: Get a trial key in one call, with no account: 50 calls over 7 days

source.description: Where you found the network: oedtp, mcp, a2a, api-catalog, rapidapi, direct, app, telegram, bounty, creator_studio, pretrade_shield, shield, x_wave, or runtime_<name> / repo_<name> (default direct)

install_id.description: Optional stable id of the installing app, 8 to 64 letters, digits, _ or -; one trial key per install per day

spinoff.description: The Caelara Labs property the key was requested from: shield, kineto, edge, workbench, app, telegram (anything else counts as direct)

placement.description: Optional place on the page the key was requested from, up to 40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (for example quickstart)

tools.name: receipts__verify
tools.description: Verify a network-signed pass or receipt (compact JWS) and return its claims

receipt.description: The compact JWS, for example an execution_receipt or signed_pass
